item.title: Cruise Confirms Days of Thunder Sequel
item.description:
Cruise Confirms Days of Thunder Sequel

Tom Cruise announced a Days of Thunder sequel with Anne Hathaway in a Saturday video from Daytona International Speedway, posing beside a lime-green NASCAR car tagged for summer 2028. The confirmation did not arrive as a rumor dressed up as news. It arrived as the star standing at the sport’s most famous oval, next to sheet metal already labeled for a summer still almost two years away, and naming a co-star whose presence immediately became the other half of the story.

item.title: Cruise Green-Flags Thunder Sequel 2028
item.description:
Cruise Green-Flags Thunder Sequel 2028

Tom Cruise, 64, did not walk onto the Daytona stage the way a studio executive walks onto a panel. On Saturday he hopped a row of potted plants to get there, then told 40 Cup drivers the sentence the stock-car world has been waiting almost a generation to hear: he is bringing Cole Trickle back.

The gesture was pure Cruise — physical, slightly ridiculous, impossible to ignore — and it was also a piece of calendar work. Paramount has dated the Days of Thunder follow-up for June 2, 2028, nearly 40 years after Tony Scott’s 1990 NASCAR film. The announcement did not arrive as a sterile studio graphic. It arrived as a man of 64 climbing over landscaping in front of the people who actually drive Cup cars for a living.

item.title: Cruise Recruits Hathaway For Thunder Sequel
item.description:
Cruise Recruits Hathaway For Thunder Sequel

Hollywood has spent the better part of four decades treating Days of Thunder as a period piece that happened to mint a star marriage and a NASCAR aesthetic. On Saturday, Paramount treated it as a living franchise. The studio locked a sequel that pairs Tom Cruise with Anne Hathaway, plants a June 2, 2028 theatrical date on the calendar, and hands the keys back to Cole Trickle — the cocky stock-car driver Cruise first played in Tony Scott’s 1990 racing film. Plot details stay sealed. The image that announced the movie does not.
